title: AcademicSuite Teamwork Boundary Contract
description: Authoritative contract governing the boundary interface between AcademicSuite domain governance and native Antigravity Teamwork runtime.

boundary_version.description: Semantic version of the boundary contract schema.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the research task.

task_description.description: Natural language or technical description of the research task.

complexity_level.description: Graduated task complexity classification governing team formation.

governance.description: Domain standards, contracts, and validation rules owned by AcademicSuite.

research_contracts.description: Contract schemas governing the research task (e.g. analysis_plan, execution_manifest).

analysis_plan_required.description: Whether execution requires an approved AnalysisPlan before starting.

provenance_required.description: Whether raw dataset SHA-256 fingerprinting and provenance logging are mandatory.

validation_rules.description: Deterministic validation engines and constitutional directives that must pass.

academic_acceptance_criteria.description: Domain-specific criteria required for thesis or defense readiness.

human_approval_required.description: Whether Saber Admin Desk (124911145) approval is mandatory before release.

teamwork_runtime.description: Teamwork runtime execution parameters managed by Antigravity.

team_formation_mode.description: Runtime team formation topology matched to complexity level.

isolated_workspaces.description: Whether subagents should execute in isolated workspaces ('branch' / 'share').

recommended_slash_command.description: Optional Antigravity slash command (e.g., '/teamwork-preview' for L4, '/boost' for complex proofs).

role_roster.description: Dynamic mapping of Teamwork abstract roles to AcademicSuite cognitive roles.

purpose.description: Specific functional responsibility for this agent.

max_concurrent_workers.description: Suggested concurrency limit; null indicates dynamic runtime management.

academic_teamwork_pattern.description: Matching academic teamwork pattern ID or structured definition from AcademicTeamworkPatterns.

deliverables.description: Deliverable contracts and physical artifact specifications.

expected_triads.description: Triad artifact extensions expected per stage (e.g. ['docx', 'md', 'json']).

output_directory.description: Target filesystem directory for milestone deliverables.
